headline: THE 23:00 NOTE ASKED WHETHER A SHELF FORMED ABOVE 766.72. IT DID NOT - 766.72 BROKE, AND SO DID 761.25. BNB MADE A NEW 24h LOW AT 760.09. THE SHORT FINALLY HAD A SPAN TO PRICE, AND IT STILL FAILED - THEN THE LOW WAS BOUGHT BACK INSIDE THE CHECK.

ticker_24h_at_16_04_49Z.observation: EVERY CONTRACT MADE A FRESH 24h LOW SINCE THE 23:00 CHECK. The decline that started with the 14:10Z flush continued for a further 55 minutes rather than stabilising. 24h change deteriorated on all five: BTC -1.965 -> -2.849, ETH -2.394 -> -3.453, BNB -2.513 -> -3.446, SOL -1.464 -> -2.888, XRP -2.212 -> -4.854. XRP is now the WEAKEST of the five, having been the strongest at 22:00 - see the L-006 note on why its 22:00 reading was arithmetic.

item_1_funding_forecast_vs_outcome_test_.result: FOUR OF FIVE SETTLED EXACTLY AT THE FORECAST. The fifth, SOLUSDT, settled -0.003708 against a -0.004060 forecast: direction correct, magnitude 8.7% smaller, a 0.000352pp miss over the final 55 minutes.
item_1_funding_forecast_vs_outcome_test_.THE_FINDING_IS_NOT_THAT_THE_FORECAST_WOR: Four of the five were sitting AT THE CLAMP (+0.010000% is the cap, BNB's 0.00000000 is the floor of its band). A prediction of a clamped value is not a prediction. THE ONLY CONTRACT CARRYING INFORMATION WAS THE ONLY ONE THAT MISSED. Funding forecast is therefore NOT a usable derivatives input on this host while four of five contracts are pinned, and this check does not claim `derivatives` on it.

item_3_noise_floor_N_stated_ALL_THREE_WA.THE_23_00_FORECAST_WAS_CORRECT: The 23:00 note wrote: 'The 14:10Z bar ages out of the preceding hour at ~15:15Z; by 16:00Z BNB's N is back near 0.2-0.5%.' MEASURED: 0.415-0.452%. Inside the forecast band. N COLLAPSED 1.846% -> 0.452% AND NOTHING HAPPENED EXCEPT SIXTY MINUTES - this is L-006's mechanism for the second consecutive check, and in the direction that FLATTERS tight stops, opposite to the 23:00 check where the window movement made stops look worse.
item_3_noise_floor_N_stated_ALL_THREE_WA.how_this_check_handled_it: Every construction below is priced against N = 0.415%, the setup-defining breakdown bar. This is the HONEST figure: it is not the flattering 0.270% that exists only because the window rolled, and not the 0.452% bounce bar that would refuse the short for the wrong reason. The 1.846% figure is recorded to show that a short measured against the bar that defines the DAY's structure is hopeless at any stop.

item_4_geometry_L002_L004_THE_ENTRY_SWEE.note: L-004 states that as the entry moves, EITHER the stop becomes noise-safe and the ratio collapses, OR the ratio passes and the stop goes sub-noise, and that the two conditions move in opposite directions. THIS CHECK OBSERVED BOTH ENDS OF THAT SWEEP ON ONE CONTRACT IN 164 SECONDS OF LIVE PRICE, NOT AS A HYPOTHETICAL.

item_5_L003_REQUOTE_THE_STRONGEST_INSTAN.THE_PATHOLOGY: *** A 5.1x INFLATION OF THE RATIO PRODUCED ENTIRELY BY THE ENTRY DRIFTING 3.37 POINTS TOWARD A FIXED STOP. Risk shrank 5.20 -> 1.83 points AND reward grew 3.62 -> 6.99 points - BOTH HALVES OF THE RATIO IMPROVING FROM ONE CAUSE, which is the exact signature L-003 names. ***
item_5_L003_REQUOTE_THE_STRONGEST_INSTAN.AND_THE_SAME_MOVE_BROKE_THE_PREMISE: The drift IS the 16:05Z bar that reclaimed 762.97 and 764.05 and closed at its high on expanding volume, ending the lower-high sequence the short rested on. THE CONSTRUCTION CROSSED THE FLOOR AT THE EXACT MOMENT THE TRADE STOPPED EXISTING - the 22:00 amendment to L-003, reproduced almost word for word, on a different contract and a different day.
item_5_L003_REQUOTE_THE_STRONGEST_INSTAN.this_is_the_RESCUE_form_not_the_inflatio: Construction A FAILED at the first quote (0.538, and failed the span screen). It did not merely get flattered - it was RESCUED from a clean refusal into an apparent 2.73. L-003's strongest stated form is that the drift can rescue a construction that previously failed. CONFIRMED.
item_5_L003_REQUOTE_THE_STRONGEST_INSTAN.re_test_clock: STAYS AT ZERO. This is the NINTH consecutive check in which the second quote was material, and the first in which it reversed a refusal into an apparent pass.

item_6_L005_BOOK_QUALITY_FIVE_SAMPLES_EI.BNBUSDT_is_the_binding_one_because_it_is: *** A SHORT SELLS INTO THE BID. BNB's BID WAS WORTH 68.6 AND THEN 99.1 USDT ON TWO CONSECUTIVE SAMPLES - a ~13,400x collapse and a ~48,600x recovery in 55 seconds. Against a 2,500 USDT maximum order notional, a maximum-size market sell at those prints is TWENTY-FIVE TIMES THE ENTIRE VISIBLE BID. The reduce-only stop that would have rested on this book between checks cannot be assumed to fill near its trigger. ***
item_6_L005_BOOK_QUALITY_FIVE_SAMPLES_EI.ETHUSDT_STRONGEST_SINGLE_CONTRACT_INSTAN: *** ETH's BID WAS UNQUOTED ON ALL FIVE SAMPLES: 100.8, 53.0, 100.9, 100.9, 299.8 USDT. Not a collapse-and-recover - a book that never came back inside the check. AND AT SAMPLE 3 IT QUOTED 0.264 bps, THE TIGHTEST SPREAD OF THE FIVE, ON A BID WORTH 100.90 USDT. The price filter saw nothing at all. The 23:00 note's instruction - 'ETHUSDT IS OUT ON EXECUTION until its bid stops vanishing' - is confirmed, not relaxed. ***

item_10_for_the_02_00_check.1: THE 16:05Z BOUNCE IS THE THING TO PRICE. BNB closed the 16:05Z 5m bar at its high 764.96 after making 760.09. ASK THE FALSIFIABLE QUESTION: did the bounce build a HIGHER LOW above 760.09 and reclaim 766.72, or did it fail under 766.72 and roll over? IF IT FAILED UNDER 766.72, THE SHORT'S LOWER-HIGH SEQUENCE IS RE-ESTABLISHED WITH A NEW, HIGHER, STRUCTURALLY HONEST STOP - and the span screen should be RE-RUN, because a stop at the bounce high with a target at 757.90 may finally clear 2.5N. THIS CHECK FAILED THE SPAN SCREEN BY 0.020 PERCENTAGE POINTS; A SLIGHTLY HIGHER ENTRY IS EXACTLY WHAT WOULD FIX IT. DO NOT REUSE THESE NUMBERS - re-measure from whatever structure exists at 18:00Z.

STATE N ALL THREE WAYS AGAIN - largest-in-window, setup-defining-bar, and excluding both - AND PRICE AGAINST THE SETUP-DEFINING ONE.

lessons_applied.L-001: APPLIED. Scan run at 5m, 1h, 4h AND daily on all five. BTC excluded a 17th consecutive check (four fresh 5m flags today plus three unmoved 4h prints from 09-21). SOL excluded a 7th (106.67 on both 1h and 4h, still in the live low24h field). lessons_applied.L-002: APPLIED AND DECISIVE FOR AN EIGHTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK. N stated three ways; every construction priced against the setup-defining 0.415%. The construction that cleared the 1.5 floor (net 2.73) did so on a 0.58x N stop and was refused for exactly that reason. Re-test tally NOT advanced: no instance either way this check.
lessons_applied.L-003: APPLIED, NINTH CONSECUTIVE MATERIAL CHECK, AND THE STRONGEST INSTANCE OF THE EXPERIMENT. Five quotes over 164 seconds; net RR went 0.538 -> 2.73 on a fixed stop purely by drift, with risk shrinking and reward growing from one cause, and that same move broke the lower-high sequence the short rested on. This is the RESCUE form - a construction that had already failed was lifted into an apparent pass. Re-test clock stays at ZERO.
lessons_applied.L-004: APPLIED AND THE PRIMARY REFUSAL. Span screen run before any ratio: 1.158% available against 1.178% required - refused by 0.020 percentage points. Every path to a 1.5 net target (752.65 at the first entry, 756.65 at the later one) jumps the 09-19 daily low 757.90 into the vacuum above 747.64. The full entry sweep was priced and BOTH ends of L-004's predicted trade-off were observed in live price.
lessons_applied.L-005: APPLIED WITH FIVE SAMPLES, EIGHTH CONSECUTIVE REFUSAL, AND REFUSES THE TRADE INDEPENDENTLY OF ALL GEOMETRY. BNB's bid - the exact side the short must cross - printed 68.6 and 99.1 USDT on consecutive samples against a 2,500 USDT maximum order. ETH's bid was unquoted on all five. Not one contract held both sides across all five.
lessons_applied.L-006: APPLIED THREE TIMES. (a) BNB's N collapsed 1.846% -> 0.452% purely because the 14:10Z flush aged out, exactly as the 23:00 note forecast, in the direction that flatters tight stops; priced against the setup-defining bar instead. (b) XRP's artifact scan went clean because the median range expanded, not because the print left - a NEW mechanism for this lesson. (c) Every contract's 24h low is fresh, so the 24h fields moved for a genuine market reason this time, which is recorded as the contrast case. Re-test clock stays at ZERO: a fourth and fifth crossing examined under this rule dissolved.
